data.one_liner: Provides country details, ISO codes, and dial codes based on localization.
data.what_it_does: Fetches region and country details such as ISO 3166 codes (alpha-2, alpha-3), dial codes, and country names based on a provided or device locale. It also includes a TextInputFormatter to handle dial codes dynamically in form fields.
use_when: You need to access country dial codes and ISO codes based on the device or custom locale.
You are building phone number input forms that require automatic dial code formatting.
avoid_when: You only need language and locale translations without country specific metadata.
You need an exhaustive country picker widget out of the box (this is primarily a data helper package).
strengths: Provides localized country names and dial codes easily.
Includes a built-in DialCodeFormatter for text form fields.
Supports both device region detection and custom locales.
weaknesses: Requires manual initialization via CountryCodes.init() before use.
Limited to basic country details and a single text input formatter.
data.setup_notes: Must call await CountryCodes.init() before invoking package methods.
